attr.title: F-Zero SNES Recomp
attr.desc: A native recompilation of F-Zero for SNES, ported to handhelds through PortMaster. This is not an emulator: it runs the original game logic recompiled to native code, with widescreen/Fit aspect ratio, save states, rewind, and optional BS F-Zero Deluxe content. You must provide your own legally dumped F-Zero (USA) ROM; none is included.
attr.inst: Requires your own legally dumped F-Zero (USA) .sfc or .smc ROM. After installing this port, copy that ROM file into the FZeroSNESRecomp folder created by PortMaster, then launch the port.
